values.note: Unserviced C$34, electric C$40, full hookup C$47.25; a site with a fire pit costs C$13.75 more. Showers included.

fees.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/visit/tarifs-fees ('Unserviced with washroom building having toilets and showers $34.00', with fire pit $47.75; 'Electrical $40.00', with fire pit $53.75; 'Full service $47.25', with fire pit $61.00; 'Online reservation $11.50'; page dated 2025-12-04); https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/camping ('Shower use is included in the campsite fee'); read 2026-11-10

values.note: Booked through the Parks Canada Reservation Service (online or 1-877-737-3783). Check-in after 2 pm, check-out before 11 am. Six people per site. Generators 8-10 am and 5-7 pm only.

booking.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/camping (Whistlers 'Reservable: Yes'; 'The Parks Canada Reservation Service will launch for frontcountry camping bookings on Tuesday, January 27, 2026 at 8 am MT'; 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days'; check-in 'Any time after 2 pm') (page dated 2026-10-14, read 2026-11-10)

hookups.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/camping ('Full service and electrical-only campsites are equipped with 15, 30, and 50 amp service'; site types 'Full service', 'Electrical', 'Unserviced') (page dated 2026-10-14, read 2026-11-10); https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/visit/tarifs-fees (lists 'Full service' as its own fee class); the Waterton fee table read the same day spells the class out as 'Full service (water, sewer, electrical)'

season.source: https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/ab/jasper/activ/passez-stay/camping (2026 operating season: Whistlers 'Open: May 6 to October 12') (page dated 2026-10-14, read 2026-11-10)

note: Just south of Jasper townsite off the Icefields Parkway, the park's largest campground, recently renovated. The 2024 Jasper wildfire burned here and new growth is only starting to emerge. A trail runs to town. Perimeter wildlife fencing is being installed from fall 2026. --Claude
